name: Demo
notes:
Hi,

Just wanted to follow up — I’m available to come out on Saturday May 2nd at 5PM (party of 1-2) to make some content and post it on our Stories page. 

No need to worry about the menu — just bring out whatever you want us to show off and I’ll make it look great. 

There is no charge for my services, and the content is yours to use however you need — no copyright restrictions. I’m really looking forward to meeting you, and I appreciate everything!

Does that day and time work for you?
